description: Every update waits on the dependency dashboard until someone ticks it, and only updates Merge Confidence rates high or very high are offered.
npmrc: the hosted runner's npm refuses remote tarballs by default, but @tailwindcss/oxide's wasm fallback bundles its dependencies, so the lockfile can't be rebuilt without fetching one.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come from Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml), which also reads the lockfile; a second PR from Renovate would duplicate it.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Offered once a month, so indirect packages do not drift far behind.
schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: npm packages can be unpublished within 72 hours and hijacked releases surface in the first days, so the dashboard offers the newest version that is at least 3 days old.
Not offered until Merge Confidence rates them high or very high; a rating rises as a release ages and is adopted.
Patch and minor updates are offered together once a week as one PR.
The lint plugin is young; each release may add findings, so it is offered weekly in its own PR and the CI lint job shows the effect.
